operations.value: Reconciliation treats any concurrent description change as a conflict and hands back base, ours, and theirs for the user or agent to merge and retry. Explore whether a decision tree over git merge-file, or a granularity finer than lines, could silently resolve a useful share of them instead. Line-based merging does almost nothing for the single-paragraph descriptions this project actually holds, where any two concurrent edits collide on one line, so evaluate line, sentence, and word granularity, whether a clean automatic merge should still be reported rather than silently accepted, and what an agent receives when only part of a merge succeeds. Adopt a strategy only if it never writes conflict markers into a commit and never produces text that neither author has seen without saying so.
